title: [v0.92.1][CORP-C] Corporate IP-transfer acceptance
body:
## Outcome

Produce one accepted corporate IP-transfer acceptance record for CORP-C, with operational hardening residuals routed separately.

## Primary deliverable

One accepted corporate control-transfer/IP-transfer acceptance record covering the #497 transfer boundary and preserving evidence for the AWS-C Terraform bootstrap readback.

## Verification result

The prerequisite census passes for CORP-A (#482), CORP-B (#483), GCP-D (#493), and AWS-G (#496). The Agent Logic business AWS profile is read back through redacted retained evidence. The #497 acceptance packet records the single authorized Terraform bootstrap mutation and routes broader operational-control hardening residuals to sidecar #624.

## Sidecar boundary

Broader post-move-in operational hardening is tracked in #624 and does not block #497 closure. That sidecar owns GitHub/CI authority hardening, DNS and certificate ownership/rollback readbacks, AWS account guardrails, private custody receipt, and deployment rollback readback.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one corporate IP-transfer acceptance decision for CORP-C. Operational hardening rows discovered during closeout are preserved as #624 follow-up scope rather than reopened #497 blockers.

## Dependencies

- CORP-A: #482
- CORP-B: #483
- AWS-G: #496
- GCP-D: #493

## Retained predecessor scope

- #157
- #158
- #159

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] CORP-A, CORP-B, AWS-G, and GCP-D prerequisite issue/PR ancestry is retained.
- [x] AWS uses the approved business-account profile for #497 evidence and records only redacted account-hash readback.
- [x] Terraform bootstrap authority is company-controlled for #497 scope and the authorized AWS-C bootstrap apply/readback is retained.
- [x] Operational hardening residuals are explicitly routed to nonblocking sidecar #624.

## Owned paths

- `docs/operations/corporate/control-transfer/**`
- `infra/**`
- `.github/workflows/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/corporate/corp-c/**`

## PVF lanes

- `control-plane-readback`
- `aws-business-account`
- `deployment-rollback`
- `secret-redaction`

## Stop conditions

- A production mutation lacks operator authorization.
- Credential or private custody material would be exposed.
- #624 is misrepresented as complete.

## Non-goals

- Completing #624 operational hardening inside #497.
- Unreviewed production cutover.
- Credential disclosure.
- Replacing counsel or committing private diligence material.
